actionsDescription: The buyer sees every change on their order.
stageHint: Optional label shown to the buyer while the order is accepted.
dispatchBlocked: Resolve the pending cancellation request before dispatching.
acceptDescription: {buyer} is notified. Goods and delivery stay as submitted.
fulfillmentHint: Optional; frozen on the order once accepted.
rejectDescription: {buyer} sees your reason. Reserved stock is restored.
cancelDescription: {buyer} sees your reason. Reserved stock is restored. This can't be undone.
cancelDescriptionPending: The buyer's pending cancellation request is resolved by this cancellation. Reserved stock is restored. This can't be undone.
dispatchDescription: The whole order leaves your warehouse. It can't be cancelled afterwards.
deliverDescription: The order is complete. This can't be undone.
